01G0.reason: Proves the comodule/group-grading equivalence by coefficient projections, then checks the conjugation compatibility on the group basis; arbitrary field and group.

01G1.reason: Constructs and verifies one induced group-graded module; balancing, coset representatives and degrees checked; canonical centralizer, representation and tensor-product definitions reused.

01G2.reason: States precisely the simple Yetter–Drinfeld parameterization, not Nichols classification; arbitrary-characteristic scope justified by the separate proof.

01G3.reason: Proves bijective parameterization by an explicit isomorphism and inverse subobject correspondence; no Maschke or Nichols classification input.

01G4.reason: One group-base bosonization theorem, with all homogeneous-degree conventions and the actual antipode; no assertion of general splitting.

01G5.reason: Checks associativity, unit, coassociativity, both counits, multiplicativity, and both antipode identities; noncommuting group-factor order checked separately.

01G6.reason: Complete verification of the comodule-algebra module-category construction: action, maps, associator, unit, naturality, pentagon and triangle; no exactness/Morita classification claim.

01G7.reason: One explicit nonabelian S3 braiding; distinguishes simple graded object from irreducible underlying group representation and avoids a Nichols dimension claim.

01H0.reason: Adds the missing specialized induced relational embedding definition, reusing 00CB/00GD/00GQ; explicitly permits the empty structure rather than duplicating ordinary first-order structures.

01H1.reason: Defines exactly finite partial-isomorphism extension; does not conflate it with elementary embeddings or arbitrary partial injections.

01H2.reason: Defines the finite embedded-structure age and finite-type condition; distinguishes isomorphism classes from actual subsets and embeddings.

01H3.reason: Defines jointly covering marked amalgams and their isomorphisms; extra overlap allowed, no strong-amalgamation assumption.

01H4.reason: States all assumptions of the precise Fraïssé class variant used here; derives joint embedding from empty amalgamation and flags the unbounded-size restriction.

01H5.reason: Complete tuple-orbit proof accounts for repeated coordinates and labeling, including both directions of finite-type versus oligomorphic equivalence.

01H6.reason: Defines the exact finite embedding extension property needed for the construction and back-and-forth, with empty-source case explicit.

01H7.reason: Precise finite-type infinite Fraïssé existence/uniqueness theorem, linked to its actual construction proof and the separate orbit criterion.

01H8.reason: Complete finite-task scheduling construction, age verification, eventual satisfaction of every task, back-and-forth uniqueness and homogeneity; no appeal to Fraïssé existence as black box.

01H9.reason: Complete transitivity, open-stabilizer and restriction-surjectivity proof; explicitly does not claim fullness of the embedding-set functor.

01HA.reason: States the marked-amalgam pullback decomposition with correct variance and no spurious automorphism factors; sources' inconsistent target labels normalized.

01HB.reason: Proves finiteness, surjectivity, injectivity, equivariance and orbit identification, preserving extra intersections and both marking maps.

01HC.reason: Fully proves only group measure to finite-structure measure; deliberately does not upgrade it to the full relative universal-ring comparison.

01HD.reason: Complete canonical-orbit-structure argument; correct automorphism group is the topological closure, not an arbitrary nonclosed original group.

01HE.reason: One exact orbit trace-pairing formula and determinant criterion; determinant convention defined locally; no nilpotent-trace conclusion.

01HF.reason: Complete finite-orbit integral calculation proving the pairing formula and nondegeneracy, using the already proved Fubini lemma, not any deep trace theorem.

complete_proofs.scope: All objects and morphisms in the equivalence between kG-comodules and G-graded spaces; compatibility with group action gives the Yetter–Drinfeld conjugation condition, over any field and any group.
Construction verification: balancing, coset decomposition, well-defined degree and conjugation compatibility of the centralizer-induced module.

Simple Yetter–Drinfeld objects for a finite group are parameterized by conjugacy classes and irreducible centralizer representations; explicit isomorphism and subobject correspondence. No Nichols classification or semisimplicity input.

Every ordinary Hopf axiom for the group-base bosonization, including both antipode identities, from the stated braided Hopf axioms. Arbitrary possibly nonabelian G; not the general Radford–Majid splitting theorem.
Action, functoriality, associator, unit, naturality and coherence of the finite-dimensional comodule-algebra module-category construction; no exactness, indecomposability or Morita classification.
Full marked/repeated-tuple orbit criterion and both directions of finite-type age versus oligomorphic automorphism group for an ultrahomogeneous relational structure.

Existence, exact age, extension property, uniqueness, homogeneity and equivalence of the two characterizations for finite-type, unbounded-size Fraïssé classes in countable relational languages; finite-stage scheduling and back-and-forth included.
